messages:
Mira: heads-up — eu-west1 just had a mini wave of pod evictions during a rolling drain window, seen ~18 pods bounced in 12m. many nodes show tiny leftover GPU fractions (0.25-1.0) leading to fragmentation and scheduling tail latency spikes. dashboards: https://redwood.metrics/eu-west1/gpu-allocs :grimacing:
Ashok: looking at scheduler logs — a lot of spready podAntiAffinity and strict topology constraints from embedder jobs. they request 1 GPU but explicitly avoid co-locating which kills binpacking. sample log: `predicate failed: PodAntiAffinity`
Nate: can we run a short consolidation pass? patch idea: add softPreferred podAntiAffinity instead of required, or run a rescheduler that prefers packing. also we could temporarily increase binpack scoring weight in the scheduler policy.
Sloane: caution — we disabled autoscaler burst in eu-west1 last month to cut costs. if we enable 10% burst for 30m we can absorb the wave, but cost hit ~ $1.1k/day if sustained. tradeoff: fewer evictions vs $$$.
k8s-bot: cluster-autoscaler: scaledDown 6 nodes in the last_hour (reason: scaleDownDelay). 4 of them had GPUs with <=0.5 allocated.
Ashok: short-term mitigation plan: 1) enable short autoscaler burst (30m) 2) deploy a node-consolidation job that cordons low-util nodes and re-binds pods (low risk) 3) run a one-off scheduler tweak: increase binpackingWeight to 30 for 2h.
Mira: agree. can someone run the consolidation job now? I'd rather avoid manual drains that spike churn.
Nate: I'll kick off the consolidation job in 5m. command I'm using: ```bash
# consolidate small-gpu fragments
kubectl label nodes --selector='gpu=true,free<1' consolidate=true
kubectl apply -f jobs/consolidate-gpu-fragments.yaml
```
Sloane: also opening a short PR to change embedder helm values so podAntiAffinity is preferred not required. should be low-risk for correctness tests.
Ashok: for safety add a 10m cooldown on the consolidation job so we don't oscillate with autoscaler. also add `--eviction-timeout=2m` to the job's drain step.
autoscaler-bot: autoscaler: burst mode toggled ON for eu-west1 (cap +10% for 30m) by @Sloane.
Mira: after consolidation run, please post a snapshot of token-latency P95 and eviction count. if p95 drops and evictions stop, we keep burst for 30m then revert.
Nate: job started -> job/pod-rescheduler-202.json, tracking logs: https://logs.redwood/jobs/pod-rescheduler-202. will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
Ashok: long-term action items (noting for roadmap): a) scheduler plugin for gpu-aware compaction b) per-job affinity templates (prefer vs require) c) autoscaler cost-aware burst policies. I'll create GH issues.
Mira: thanks — running watch now. assigning followups: Ashok -> infra PR for scheduler param toggle, Sloane -> helm PR for embedder affinity, Nate -> consolidation job run + metrics.
Sloane: FYI cost estimate if burst left on 24h: ~ $1.1k/day, if we only use 30m it's ~ $12. keep eyes on billing.
Nate: update: first consolidation pass moved 14 pods, freed 5 GPU-slices, eviction rate dropped 60% in first 8m. posting charts in a sec.
Mira: nice, will monitor for residual stragglers and mark this thread resolved once eviction rate is normal for 30m. :white_check_mark:
